line: Capacitive soil moisture sensor v1.2 or v2.0
role: LoRa ecosystem device: farm sensor node payload
spec: Capacitive soil moisture probe of the common v1.2 or v2.0 design: single piece corrosion resistant board, analogue output, 3.3 to 5.5 V supply, three pin lead. Capacitive rather than the resistive fork, which corrodes away in weeks.
why: One of the two readings the ESP32-C3 farm node publishes on demo D6, which is what makes the node a real third party device with something to say rather than a traffic generator.

candidates.title: 1/3 PCS Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Corrosion Resistant for R3 Board Moisture Detection Garden Watering DIY
candidates.price_note: KSh 136 with free shipping, so KSh 136 landed, for the single sensor; the listing also sells a 3 pack. Item page rendered only its gallery, so the pack prices could not be read. No Choice or Welcome deal badge seen.
candidates.notes: Cheapest landed price on the line at KSh 136 with free shipping, and the strongest evidence of any candidate that clears both rules: 2,000+ sold at a genuine 4.9. Every capacitive sensor on this page is the same reference board, so the choice is really about which seller to trust, and this one has the record. The title does not state v1.2 or v2.0, which is the one gap against the spec, but the board in the gallery is the standard single piece capacitive probe with the three pin lead, and the two revisions differ only in the regulator fitted. No photo check was required on this line and none was made beyond reading the gallery thumbnails.

notes: One search, capacitive soil moisture sensor v1.2 corrosion resistant, returned fifty genuine capacitive sensors, so no second search was run. Every listing on the page is the same reference board, so this line was decided on seller record and landed price rather than on the part. One trap worth recording for later scouts: the search card scraper reads a number out of the title when the card carries no rating, so listings titled 3.3~5.5V reported a rating of 3.3 and listings titled V1.2 reported 1.2. Those are not ratings and were treated as unknown here; any scout reading these files should not take a sub 4.0 figure on this category at face value. Neither item page rendered its text, both came back titled Aliexpress with no price, store, rating or shipping, so store name, store URL, review count and pack prices are unverified for every candidate and all figures come from the search cards.
